entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, um... I need some help. I think I ordered the wrong thing and I'm a bit lost on what to do.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. I can certainly help you today. To get started, could I get your name and order number please?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti. Order number... VF88621. The website was a little confusing for me.

No problem at all, Maria. I'm pulling up your order now. I see the Aero Race Jersey, delivered four days ago. To make sure I get you to the right place, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the jersey or more of a preference issue?
Oh, a preference, I guess? I got the jersey and it's the wrong size. It's just way too tight across the shoulders. I'm not sure what the process is. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can absolutely help you with that. It sounds like you need a different fit. Since the jersey is a standard apparel item and you received it just a few days ago, you're well within our 90-day return period. We can definitely get this sorted out.
Oh, that's such a relief! So... what do I do?
We have two simple options. We can process an exchange for a larger size, or I can set up a return for a full refund. Which would you prefer?
I'd love to do an exchange, please. I really like the design, it was just the sizing.

Excellent choice. I have just initiated that exchange in our system. You'll be receiving an email from VeloFit in the next few minutes. It will contain a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just place the current jersey in a package, apply the label, and you can drop it off. As soon as we see it's on its way back, we'll ship out the new size to you.
Wow, okay, that's much easier than I thought it would be. Thank you so much for your help, Isaac.
You are very welcome, Maria. I'm happy we could get that resolved for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
